description: Get a compact availability summary for an event: each time option with yes/maybe/no counts, who voted, and your own response. Identify the event with an owner_token or share_token (the last part of /e/{token}).

event_id.description: Optional event ID; if given it must match the token's event. Not needed: the token identifies the event.

token.description: The token from a personal link (the last part of /e/{token}). May be either an organizer owner_token or a participant share_token; the server works out which.

name: get_summary
